name: Head Pose Estimation v2
description: Analyzes head pose physics and rotation
algorithm: Head Pose Estimation v2 — 像素级空间分析
mechanism:
This method analyzes 视频 frames for deepfake and AI generation detection:

1. **Frame Extraction**: Key frames are extracted from the 视频 stream for analysis.

2. **Feature Analysis**: Analyzes head pose physics and rotation. Relevant visual and temporal features are computed per frame.

3. **Temporal Consistency Check**: Features are tracked across consecutive frames to detect inconsistencies.

4. **Pattern Matching**: Results are compared against known deepfake artifact patterns.

5. **分数计算**: A confidence score (0-100) reflecting the likelihood of AI manipulation is calculated.
parameters:
分析类型: 像素
媒体: 视频
输入: Video frames extracted at key intervals
输出: 置信度分数 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 中到高 — 70-88% 独立准确率. Most effective when combined with other 视频 forensic methods. Performance depends on 视频 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 视频 through head pose estimation v2 analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 视频 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 视频 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 视频 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 视频 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 视频

references.title: Yang, X. et al. (2019). Exposing Deep Fakes Using Inconsistent Head Poses. ICASSP.
Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
